$Comment: A nightly contract on Old Jack's board: its Parent posts it in the night slots. Geode Wraiths walk only at night, in the unlit mineshafts of the first three zones, and only while the event runs, so the work is always out in the world, never at the temple. The step's own TextKey words it. It writes its own Rewards.Claim, the base's list with MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Xp row added (Defense XP for the fight), because a child's list replaces the base's whole; the pay waits at the board until the player collects it. Its own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves the row out on a server without that mod, and the rest of the contract pays.
